Making digital tools useful in local, everyday work.

Today, alongside marketing support and website creation, I run workshops for local business owners and share community information.

privacyDescription: Learn how Spady handles personal information, inquiry details, cookies, and the use of external services.
privacyIntro: Spady takes care in handling the information you share with us through your inquiries. This page explains what information this website collects, why we use it, and how we manage it.

privacySections.title: Website operator and contact
privacySections.text: This website (spady.net) is operated by Spady (representative: Hiroshi Inoue; based in Zenibako, Otaru, Hokkaido, Japan). Please use our contact page for questions or requests regarding the handling of personal information.

privacySections.title: Information we collect
privacySections.text: Through our contact form, we collect your name, company or business name, email address, inquiry category and message, preferred meeting dates and times, consent status, and language used. You can submit an inquiry without completing optional fields. To deliver and protect the website, our hosting service may process communication information such as your IP address and the date and time of access.

privacySections.title: How we use information
privacySections.text: We use information to respond to inquiries, confirm the details of your request, arrange meetings, make proposals and communicate about your request, provide services, and prevent misuse. With your consent, we also use information for measurement to improve the website and understand advertising performance. We do not use collected information for purposes unrelated to these without your authorization.

privacySections.title: External services and service providers
privacySections.text: We use Cloudflare to deliver the website and receive inquiries. Submitted inquiries are sent through Lark’s notification features to a destination managed by Spady, where the person responsible can review them. Depending on each service’s infrastructure and contractual arrangements, information may be processed outside Japan. Please also refer to each service’s privacy policy for details of how information is handled.

privacySections.title: Cookies and website measurement
privacySections.text: This website uses Google Tag Manager. On the new homepage, contact page, and this policy page in each language, measurement tags load after you consent to cookies. You can browse the website and submit inquiries without consenting. Your cookie choice and motion display settings are saved in your browser’s local storage. You can change your choice using “Change cookie settings.” Changing your choice to decline does not withdraw information that has already been sent. You can delete stored cookies through your browser settings.

privacySections.title: Sharing with third parties and external links
privacySections.text: We do not provide personal information to third parties without your consent, except where required by law or in other legally permitted circumstances. When we engage service providers as necessary to fulfill the stated purposes, we take care in how information is handled. Websites and services linked from this site, including LINE, Threads, and individual projects, are subject to their own privacy policies.

privacySections.title: Information management and retention
privacySections.text: This website encrypts communications using HTTPS, and inquiry notification destinations are managed on the server side. We handle information to the extent necessary to respond to inquiries. Information that is no longer needed is deleted or organized, taking into account legal retention obligations and other relevant considerations.

privacySections.title: Requests for disclosure, correction, or suspension of use
privacySections.text: If you would like notification of the purposes for which your personal information is used, disclosure, correction, deletion, suspension of use, suspension of provision to third parties, or similar action, please contact us through our contact page. We will verify your identity and respond in accordance with applicable laws.

privacySections.title: Changes to this policy
privacySections.text: We may review this policy as our services or information handling practices change. The revised policy and its update date will be posted on this page.
